title: NRO Program B ground element at Pine Gap

tellings.quote: the ground element of NRO program B was established at Pineap Australia.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the ground part of Program B, a branch of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US spy satellite agency, was set up at Pine Gap, a secretive satellite station in Australia. He places this in the 1980s, as part of a wider picture of how hidden US intelligence programmes are spread out and run.
